request: Can you move this label in the middle please
answer:
The Mermaid view I draw from has no way to set where a label sits on an edge, so I can't make this change as a proposal. An edge's label is text attached to its arrow, and the editor places that text along the arrow's path itself. When the label isn't in the middle, it's usually because of the arrow's shape — for example, it has a bend point or is routed around a frame.

You can fix it in the editor:
- select the arrow `7 review stamp moves` and drag its bend handle until the line is straight, or remove the extra point; or
- move `review` (Review store) or `GET /api/diagram/events` so the arrow runs straight between them.

Either way the editor puts the label back at the middle. If you'd like me to propose moving one of those two nodes, reply here with which one and roughly where it should go.
